logging.recommendation: Use logger.ts' existing `initFileLogger()` pattern as the model. Create a lightweight `formatLogLine(timestamp: string, ...args)` export from logger.ts that all console.* calls throughout the codebase can use OPTIONALLY. The cleanest, lowest-churn path is: (1) Export a `log(msg)`, `warn(msg)`, `error(msg)` trio from logger.ts that PREPEND `[HH:MM:SS]` to every line; (2) Incrementally replace raw console.* calls with these helpers (can land gradually in PRs, one file at a time); (3) For immediate global coverage with zero file edits: extend the existing console.* patches in initFileLogger() to ALSO prepend the timestamp to stdout (not just the file), so all logs—even unadjusted ones—auto-gain timestamps. Option 3 is fastest (one edit at line 34 in logger.ts: prepend timestamp to origLog call), but loses the ability to strip timestamps if needed. Option 1+2 is slower to roll out but gives fine-grained control. Recommend starting with Option 3 for rapid value, then grad to Option 1+2 as logs are normalized.

llmMeta.resultShape:
There is NO LlmResult/LlmCallResult/LlmStreamResult type. The actual result types in packages/engine/src/llm-types.ts are:

LlmCallResponse (llm-types.ts:87) — non-stream result:
  content: string
  finishReason: FinishReason            // 'stop' | 'length' | 'schema_violation' | 'error' (line 85)
  usage?: {
    promptTokens: number
    completionTokens: number
    cacheReadTokens?: number
    cacheCreationTokens?: number
    costUsd?: number
  }
  providerId: string
  modelId: string

LlmStreamChunk (llm-types.ts:117) — per-chunk for streaming:
  type: 'token' | 'done' | 'error'
  content?: string
  error?: Error
  usage?: { promptTokens: number; completionTokens: number; cacheReadTokens: number; cacheCreationTokens: number; costUsd: number }  // only on final 'done' chunk

LlmUsageEvent (llm-types.ts:160) — the per-call telemetry record ALREADY emitted by the façade after every call:
  timestamp: number; task: LlmTask; agentId?: string; providerId: string; modelId: string;
  finishReason: FinishReason; promptTokens, completionTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens: number;
  costUsd: number; latencyMs: number; hadSchema: boolean

LlmRoute (llm-types.ts:201): provider, model, maxTokens?, sampling?, fallback?: LlmRoute, warm?: boolean, schemaInPrompt?: boolean
LlmRouterConfig (llm-types.ts:216): default: LlmRoute; routes: Partial<Record<LlmTask, LlmRoute>>
usageFields: cacheReadTokens (optional on LlmCallResponse, required on LlmStreamChunk)
costUsd (USD, exact for claude-code via result.total_cost_usd, always 0 for lm-studio local)
llmMeta.latencyNotes: Latency IS already measured. Each façade fn captures `const startMs = Date.now()` immediately AFTER `await sem.acquire()` (classify llm-client.ts:96, generate :164, generateStream :214, embed :286) and computes `latencyMs: Date.now() - startMs` inside the emitUsage helper (:53) / inline _emitUsage calls (:266, :302, :318). Note: this is wall-clock INCLUDING nothing before acquire but INCLUDING the full provider round-trip; it does NOT isolate provider.call() time from semaphore-held overhead (acquire happens before startMs, so queue-wait is excluded — good). No per-provider internal timing exists; if you want pure provider.call latency it already is that (startMs is set right before the try{provider.call}). Cost-gate-blocked calls pass `Date.now()` as startMs so they log ~0ms (classify :90, generate :158).
llmMeta.centralCallSite: There is no single class chokepoint — llm-client.ts is a façade of 4 free functions, not a router class with call()/stream(). The true single funnel for ALL non-stream telemetry is the local helper `emitUsage()` at packages/engine/src/llm-client.ts:31-56, which every non-stream path (classify success :118, classify provider-throw :115, classify cost-gate :90, generate success :185, generate throw :182, generate cost-gate :158) calls; it forwards to `_emitUsage()` (llm-registry.ts:87). The nearest thing to a provider-dispatch chokepoint is `callWithSchemaRetry()` (llm-registry.ts:188) which wraps provider.call() for classify, while generate calls provider.call() directly at llm-client.ts:168. embed has its own inline _emitUsage at :290 and :307 (does NOT use the emitUsage helper). So: telemetry chokepoint = emitUsage helper (llm-client.ts:31); provider-call chokepoints = classify→llm-registry.ts:188/:204 and generate→llm-client.ts:168.
llmMeta.streamCallSite: Streaming funnels through `generateStream()` in packages/engine/src/llm-client.ts:200-273. The provider.stream() loop is at :222-248; the single stream telemetry emit is the inline `_emitUsage({...})` at :254-268 (run in the try-block's tail, always reached). Real usage comes from the final 'done' chunk (:245-247, populated by claude session.ts mapUsage() :245); LM Studio emits 'done' with NO usage (lm-studio/src/index.ts:148,162) so completionTokens falls back to Math.ceil(full.length/4) and cost=0 (:262,:265). Note generateStream is the ONLY streaming path — embed/classify/generate are non-stream.
llmMeta.routeTaskInScope: YES — fully in scope at every emit point. `task: LlmTask` is the first arg of classify/generate/generateStream and a literal 'embeddings' in embed. The resolved route is obtained via `_resolveRoute(task)` (classify via classifyWithRoute :78/:81, generate :154, generateStream :204, embed :277), giving route.provider and route.model. The emitUsage helper takes both the resolved route.provider/route.model (as fallback ids) AND the actual resp.providerId/resp.modelId (which can differ after a fallback route — classify recurses into route.fallback at :116/:124). So at the chokepoint you have: task name, requested provider+model (route.*), and the provider+model that actually answered (resp.* or stream route.*). warm and schemaInPrompt are also in scope (route.warm, route.schemaInPrompt) but are NOT currently forwarded into the event.
llmMeta.suggestedLogSite: Everything you asked to log EXCEPT warm? and schemaInPrompt? is ALREADY captured in LlmUsageEvent and persisted to data/llm-usage.jsonl by LlmUsageTracker.record() (llm-usage-tracker.ts:77). Existing per-call fields: task, providerId, modelId, promptTokens(in), completionTokens(out), cacheRead/CreationTokens, costUsd, latencyMs, hadSchema(=schema-was-present), finishReason, timestamp, agentId. To add the two missing flags (warm?, schemaInPrompt?): (1) add `warm: boolean; schemaInPrompt: boolean` to LlmUsageEvent (llm-types.ts:160-183); (2) thread them through the emitUsage helper signature + its single _emitUsage call (llm-client.ts:31-56) and pass route.warm/route.schemaInPrompt at each call (:90,:115,:118,:158,:182,:185), plus the stream emit (:254-268, route.warm only — stream has no schemaInPrompt) and embed emits (:290,:307 → both false). For a human-readable per-call console line (vs the JSONL), the single best place is the emitUsage helper body (llm-client.ts:~54) plus the generateStream _emitUsage at :254 and embed at :290/:307 — log `task provider/model warm=? schema=? ms=latencyMs in=promptTokens out=completionTokens cost=$costUsd finish=finishReason`. Alternatively add one console.log inside LlmUsageTracker.record() (llm-usage-tracker.ts:77) to get ALL four emit paths (classify/generate/stream/embed) from ONE place for free — this is the true single chokepoint for logging since every _emitUsage routes there.
llmMeta.notes:
Provider usage reality: (1) claude-code call() (index.ts:270-287) returns full usage — promptTokens = input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens, completionTokens = output_tokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens, and EXACT costUsd from result.total_cost_usd. Warm structured path (callWarmStructured :343) forwards session.request usage via session.ts mapUsage() (:245-254) — same fields. (2) claude-code stream via session.send 'done' chunk → mapUsage() (session.ts:156,245) — full usage incl. exact cost. (3) lm-studio call() (index.ts:94-102) returns promptTokens/completionTokens from OpenAI usage; cacheRead/Creation hardcoded 0, costUsd hardcoded 0 (local). (4) lm-studio stream() (index.ts:108-166) emits 'done' with NO usage at all (:148,:162) → façade approximates completionTokens=len/4. (5) embed: lm-studio returns usage.promptTokens, cost 0 (index.ts:187); claude-code embed throws (unsupported, index.ts:463).

GOTCHAS: (a) façade NEVER throws — all errors collapse to null/'...'; usage still emitted with finishReason='error' and zeroed tokens (llm-client.ts header + :115,:182,:307). (b) On fallback routes, the logged providerId/modelId is the one that ANSWERED (resp.*), but a separate error event is ALSO emitted for the failed primary (classify :115 then recursion emits again) — so ONE logical classify can produce MULTIPLE usage events. (c) Cost-gate-blocked calls emit an event with latency≈0 and finishReason='error' (:90,:158) — these are not real provider calls; if logging, distinguish via near-zero latency or add a 'blocked' marker. (d) Streaming LM Studio cost/tokens are approximations, not measured. (e) _emitUsage is fire-and-forget (registry.ts:87-96, Promise not awaited) — recorder errors are swallowed, won't block the call. (f) embed path does NOT use the emitUsage() helper — it inlines _emitUsage twice (:290 success, :307 error), so any helper-level change must be mirrored there.
